## Annual Houses Sold
::: {.callout-note}
Houston's housing market has experienced significant changes in sales volume over time.
:::
- 2010 had a major dip (likely due to 2008 recession)
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
txhousing |> 
  filter(city=="Houston") |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarize(sales=sum(sales)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=sales)) + 
    geom_line() + 
    ggtitle("Annual Houses Sold in Houston, TX")
```
## Average Price by Month
::: {.callout-note}
June saw the highest average sale price in the state of Texas
:::
- The average sale price does not fluctuate too drastrically between months
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
txhousing |> 
   filter(city=="Houston") |> 
    group_by(month) |> 
    summarize(avg_price=sum(volume) / sum(sales)) |> 
    mutate(month=factor(month.abb[month], 
                 levels=month.abb, ordered=TRUE)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=month, y=avg_price)) + 
    geom_bar(stat="identity") + 
    ggtitle("Average Price of Houses Sold in Texas by Month") + 
    xlab("Month") + 
    ylab("Average Sale Price") + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar)
```
## Average Price by City
::: {.callout-note}
Collin County had the highest average sale price at over $300,000 for 2015
:::
- Fort Worth had the lowest average sale price
```{r}
if(!require("tidyverse")) install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
txhousing |> filter(year==2015) |> 
    group_by(city) |> 
    summarize(avg_price=sum(volume) / sum(sales),
              num_sales=sum(sales)) |> 
    slice_max(num_sales, n=10) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=city, y=avg_price)) + 
    geom_bar(stat="identity") + 
    ggtitle("Average Price of Houses Sold in 2015 by City in Texas") + 
    xlab("City") + 
    ylab("Average Sale Price") + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar)
```
## Conclusion
::: {.fragment}
- Houston has experienced changes in the number of homes sold over time.
:::

::: {.fragment}
- Average prices vary across different months - early summer months being the highest
:::

::: {.fragment}
- Housing prices also differ substantially between major Texas cities.
:::
